execution_binding: Execute only on a clean execution_branch checkout whose HEAD is the commit adding this contract and whose first parent is pre_contract_sha. The runner independently checks the branch, clean state, parent SHA, policy digest, output path, and source SHA-256 bindings; record HEAD as EXECUTION_SHA.

scope.purpose: Add bounded nonlinear J2 performance characterization for HEX8 and HEX20 alongside the already measured TET4 and TET10 cases.
scope.measurement: solve_model wall time and Python tracemalloc peak after mesh generation/import, plus node/element/DOF/state counts, increments, Newton iterations, residual observations, and full raw result.
scope.interpretation: Descriptive characterization on one machine only. Mesh resolutions and interpolation orders differ; do not rank element efficiency or infer accuracy, convergence, scalability, or cross-machine performance.
scope.r1_preservation: WP13 R1 TET4/TET10 contract, raw files, reports, manifests, and execution record are immutable and are not overwritten or used as R2 outputs.

commands.sequence: One process; TET4 then TET10 then HEX8 then HEX20; no parallel solves.

gates.source_and_provenance: Runner must verify clean worktree, exact branch and implementation parent SHA, frozen contract, unchanged policy digest, and all contract-bound source SHA-256 values before creating the raw output directory.
gates.mesh_import: Every family imports as exactly the declared element family with mesh_status PASS. TET4/TET10 may report only the two known unused y_min/z_min physical groups; those warnings must remain recorded. No other warning is accepted by the campaign harness.
gates.campaign_status: Exactly four ordered cases must be present and each must have solver status PASS, all 24 load-path increments, finite serialized full result, finite displacement/residual data, finite positive elapsed time, and finite nonnegative tracemalloc peak. The aggregate must be PASS_INTERNAL.
gates.evidence: Preserve full per-case result.json, setup.json, mesh.msh, import_report.json, raw summary and raw report locally under raw_output_path. Version the execution record, compact report and SHA-256/size manifest; do not silently omit a raw file or hash mismatch.
gates.performance_thresholds: No time, memory, speedup, efficiency, scaling, or cross-family ranking threshold is defined. Measurements are observational only.

failure_policy: Any provenance, policy, source hash, branch, cleanliness, or output-path mismatch is FAIL_CLOSED before any solve.

Any missing family, mesh-import failure, solver failure, non-finite result, incomplete load path, or missing raw artifact is FAIL_CLOSED; preserve all outputs and do not rerun into the same directory.
Do not alter mechanics, load/material/BC/mesh definitions, solver tolerances, iteration limits, backends, or fallback behavior in response to observed performance or results.
limitations: Bounded small cyclic J2 test bar only; no qualification of all element families, material laws, solver methods, or production workloads.
Mesh density and DOF counts are not equal across all families; timings are not a controlled element-efficiency comparison.
No external-solver correlation, mesh-convergence claim, accuracy claim, performance ranking, scalability claim, or release-performance claim.
Full raw results remain local/ignored; versioned manifest hashes are integrity references, not an external archival service.
WP13 official allocation discrepancy (current ledger one point versus frozen roadmap two points) remains unresolved; R2 awards no points.
